title: Head Injury & kidney Weakness
excerpt: As life sometimes goes, we have unexpected setbacks. Recently I fell and hit my head; my skull was split wide open.
content:
As life sometimes goes, we have unexpected setbacks. Recently I fell and hit my head; my skull was split wide open. After the doctors put me back together, I immediately returned to Hippocrates where my healing was so rapid that within a short time my bruises and scars disappeared. My kidney had also been injured and I could not even lie down for the first several days. The use of the electro-magnetic therapies along with the whole program turned that around in no time. Having visited health centers around the globe, I know that there is nowhere on earth that provides as comprehensive and caring a program as this remarkable center.
